title: game-proto: All feedback
shortDescription: All issues and PRs for every game, the hub and shared code.
readme:
## All feedback

Every issue and PR from [game-proto](https://github.com/Programmer-Den/game-proto), across all 18 games, the hub and shared code. Use it for the big picture; each game also has its own Project.

- Play: [game hub](https://programmer-den.github.io/game-proto/)
- Issues: [all open issues](https://github.com/Programmer-Den/game-proto/issues)

### Views
- **Todo**: table, Status = Todo, newest first; triage here
- **One game**: table filtered `label:<game>`, e.g. `label:apothecary`
- **Bugs**: table filtered `label:bug`
- **Wishlist**: table filtered `label:feature`, sorted by reactions

### Labels
Every issue and PR has one **Game** label (a game, `hub` or `shared`) and one **Type** label (`bug`, `gameplay`, `feature`, and for PRs also `refactor`, `assets`, `docs`, `ci`). Optional: **Priority** (`high`, `medium`, `low`) and **Status** (`needs-info`, `duplicate`, `wontfix`).

Nine kinds of brain puzzle in one game, drawn as an arcane tarot deck: picture grids, bridges, code breaking, calc cages, cross sums, sliding blocks, tile flips, path links and a memory echo. Play an endless medley, the daily five, Blitz, a draft run with relics, pass and play, or practice.

title: game-proto: Mazewright
label: mazewright
shortDescription: A maze-building tower defense: plant hedges and towers, but never close the last way through.
readme:
## Mazewright

A tower defense with no road. Foes walk from their burrows to the cottage across an open lawn, always by the shortest free way, and every hedge and tower you plant is a wall in their maze. A planting that would close the last way through is refused. Three gardens, twenty waves, moths that fly straight over and moles that chew through hedges.

- Play: [Mazewright](https://programmer-den.github.io/game-proto/games/mazewright/)
- Code: [games/mazewright](https://github.com/Programmer-Den/game-proto/tree/main/games/mazewright)
